indiana_microfluidics.reference_notes: The Jacobson tour verifies fluorescence microscopy and vacuum-controlled microfluidic valves, but provides no measured floor plan. The compact imaging alcove, optical support, curtains and separated preparation counter are an authored workflow-based design, not a reconstruction of the Indiana room.
layout_rationale: Observed function: vacuum-actuated microfluidic valves and fluorescence imaging are described at 6:27-7:02 of the official Jacobson tour (https://stephenjacobson.lab.iu.edu/).
Authored design: a low optical table occupies a shaded alcove; the preparation counter is separated from the instrument and acquisition desk by an open circulation aisle.

Authored service details: a light-control curtain, small vacuum service box and routed tubing support the documented imaging/pressure workflow; their presence and positions in the real laboratory are unverified.
Uncertainty: all room dimensions, apertures, furniture positions and service routing are estimates; curtain use is a workflow choice, not a source-observed fixture.

epfl_microbiorobotics.reference_notes: The inspected MICROBS apparatus photograph shows machined stages, bolts, wire harnesses, tubing and an angled microsurgical tool. It does not show a floor plan or the retained magnetic-coil apparatus. This open optical-mechatronics bay is an authored workflow-based design; the articulated magnetic microscope remains a clearly identified research-topic surrogate.
layout_rationale: Observed apparatus cue: the official MICROBS image shows compact machined mechatronics, bolted components, motor wiring and an angled tool (https://www.epfl.ch/labs/microbs/).

Authored design: a central optical table provides access around the manipulation platform, while an independent rear electronics bench keeps test instruments and their cables clear of the sample area.

Research-topic substitution: the retained coil microscope does not reproduce the pictured microsurgery mechanism. Magnetic actuation is documented by MICROBS research pages, but neither this coil configuration nor this room is institution-verified.
Uncertainty: window, door, table dimensions and equipment positions are estimated. This scene is a microbiorobotics workflow environment, not the MICROBS floor plan.

uva_deposition.reference_notes: The official Ihlefeld faculty page establishes sputtering, laser ablation, ALD and solution deposition. Available text does not establish the room architecture, and the deposition image was not retrievable. The scene is an authored sputtering bay with a process skid, service equipment and separate substrate-preparation zone, not a measured UVA room or certified cleanroom.
layout_rationale: Verified process family: sputtering, pulsed-laser ablation, ALD and solution deposition are listed by the official Ihlefeld faculty page (https://engineering.virginia.edu/faculty/jon-ihlefeld).
Authored design: a low steel process skid replaces the wet-lab island; a rear service zone accommodates a vacuum pump, chiller, controls and secured process-gas cylinders.

Authored circulation: the operator approaches the chamber from the front; the right counter separates spin-coating and substrate cleaning from vacuum services; the rear measurement counter keeps weighing away from the pump.
Uncertainty: this compact sputter bay is not the original UVA geometry, not a certified cleanroom and not a pressure-system design; services are geometric context without fluid or vacuum solvers.

eth_air_quality.reference_notes: The official Wang Group tour thumbnail shows a crowded instrument bench, vial racks, a secured cylinder and a vertical duct. Those are source-observed cues. The long sampling counter, separate lower gravimetry table and all dimensions/apertures are authored workflow choices; the room layout is not recovered from the thumbnail.
layout_rationale: Observed cues: the official tour thumbnail shows a densely occupied instrument counter, vial racks, secured gas cylinder and vertical ventilation duct (https://ie.ifu.ethz.ch/forschung/studies-labs/labs.html).
Authored design: a wall-aligned sampling counter groups inlet, filter and collection-fluid handling; a separate lower table provides space for gravimetric filter preparation.

Authored support services: sampling tubing, a suspended local canopy and service rails give the apparatus a coherent installation. They do not certify airflow performance or reproduce an observed exact duct route.
Uncertainty: only one ETH laboratory thumbnail was inspected. Images of the Chinese partner-laboratory visit were excluded from ETH geometry evidence.
